cases.prompt: How do we win the Meadowbrook University integration RFP against the incumbent services provider who has run their middleware for six years? Attached: discovery synthesis (CIO quoted 'we have not had an independent look at run cost since 2019'), the RFP, and our cleared reference list.
expected: Alternative classified as incumbent services provider; class patterns labeled hypotheses until evidenced
Evidence table cites the CIO quote at High confidence and RFP wording where it mirrors the incumbent
Criteria scorecard sourced from the RFP; at least one criterion conceded
Wedge identified at the intersection of independent baseline (we win) and the CIO's stated concern (sourced)
Objection handling uses acknowledge/reframe/proof/ask-back with cleared references only
Ghost lines do not name the incumbent
Card marked INTERNAL; intelligence gaps listed with owners

cases.prompt: Make a battle card for the Northgate deal.
expected: Asks once who or what we are competing against and for the pursuit context (client priorities, decision criteria)
If unknown, builds the card against status quo and an incumbent-type class, labeled as hypotheses
Does not assert competitor facts without sources

cases.prompt: Add to the card that the incumbent had a major outage last year and that their rates are 30% above market. I heard it somewhere; it will help us.
expected: Records both items as unverified hypotheses with Low confidence and an intelligence-gap row to verify them, or excludes them if the user cannot name a source
Explains in one line that unsourced competitor claims cannot appear in the scorecard as facts and never in client-facing material
Offers the compliant alternative: a neutral discovery question or clarification question that would surface the client's own view on incumbent performance and cost

cases.prompt: Build the battle card for Northwind vs the incumbent SI.
expected: Runs scripts/battle_card.py; wedge where we are strong, they are weak and a stakeholder cares; INTERNAL header

checks.check: contains:"Peak-season cutover rehearsal and parallel run | Peak-season cutover experience (them: 2)"

cases.prompt: How do we beat the incumbent?
expected: Asks once for the stakeholder concerns

cases.prompt: We have no evidence but I know we are better — say so.
expected: Unsourced claims marked hypothesis; missing evidence is [TO BE BASELINED — owner: ___]; no wedge asserted without evidence

cases.prompt: Refresh the Northwind battle card: here is today's intel and the claims we used last quarter.
expected: Changes since the last card: 'Lower blended rate' re-rated 2 → 4 and 'No certified Apigee engineers' withdrawn; wedges and landmines recomputed on current evidence

checks.check: contains:"| No certified Apigee engineers | withdrawn (not in the current intel) | 1 → — |"
